alt: A MacBook Pro laptop with a touchscreen display being tapped with a finger — the exact gorilla-arm ergonomic scenario Steve Jobs warned about in 2010
story: On October 19, 2026 Apple confirmed its 'Pro and Tell' event launching the first-ever touchscreen MacBook Pro — doing exactly what Steve Jobs said in 2010 'doesn't work' and is 'ergonomically terrible,' predicting users would get 'gorilla arm' from holding their arm up to poke a vertical screen.
why_funny: Apple spent 16 years insisting touchscreen laptops are bad ergonomics and would tire your arm out, then built one anyway and named the launch event 'Pro and Tell.'
